thesis: Zuran Orb converts lands into life at zero mana, turning a resource normally protected at all costs into fuel for survival, Balance, and graveyard recursion.

competitiveTimeline.significance: The Orb became central to Necropotence-era survival, TurboZvi-style resource engines, and Lands strategies, and its policy history reflects how dangerous free sacrifice outlets can be.

playbook.role: Sacrifice lands only when the life, graveyard value, or Balance interaction exceeds the lost mana. Because the activation is free, hold it until the last responsible moment.
